story.title: Images from a mirror and a lens

scenes.heading: A picture in a spoon
sentences: Look into the bowl of a spoon and your face is small and upside down.
Where does that picture come from?

scenes.heading: A concave mirror
sentences: A concave mirror has a focal length of 0.100 metres.
An object stands 0.300 metres in front of it.
The image forms 0.150 metres from the mirror.
It is real, upside down and smaller, and the magnification is -0.500.

scenes.heading: A convex lens
sentences: Now a convex lens of focal length 0.100 metres.
The object is 0.350 metres away, beyond twice the focal length.
The image forms 0.140 metres behind the lens, real, upside down and smaller, with a magnification of -0.400.

scenes.heading: One formula
sentences: Both pictures follow the same rule between the object distance, the image distance and the focal length.
Two rays are enough to find the image.
